title: Circular No.Judicial/29/2025 with regard to issuance of Simple Copy/Certified Copy of Record & Proceedings which are received from the District Judiciary (lying in the High Court of Gujarat) on Criminal Side matters
text:
KEY LINES:
ApeDate : 03.09.2025 sistrar (Judicial)

FULL TEXT:
_ Read : (1) Rules 311 to 318A of Chapter XVII of the Criminal
Manual
(2) Rule 351 of Chapter — XXVI_ of the Gujarat High
_ Court Rules, 1993
(3) Rule 110 of Chapter — VUI of the Gujarat High Court
Rules, 1993
(4) Section 438 and 442 of CHAPTER —- XXXII
(REFERENCE AND REVISION) of the Bharatiya
Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
:: CIRCULAR ::
No.Judicial/2.4 /2025
As directed by the Honourable Chief Justice, the following. directions
~ are issued for Criminal side matters:
(1) The learned Session Judge should invariably send the copy of |
the paper book alongwith the Record and Proceedings of the
case for the use of the High Court.
(2) Henceforth, any application received from the Stakeholders or
Third Party (supported by affidavit), for getting Simple
copy/Certified Copy of the Record and Proceedings of the
concerned Sessions Court (lying in the High Court of Gujarat),
_ will not be entertained by the Registry.
(3) Registry will provide copy (simple copy) of the Paper Book
(which has been received from the concerned Sessions Court), if .
available, to the Stakeholders, as and when such application
seeking simple copy of Paper Book is received from them on
payment of the charges as prescribed in Rule 353 of the Gujarat
High Court Rules, 1993. -
(4) As and when any application received -from the Learned
Advocates/Party-in-Person of the concerned matter, in which
he/she is appearing, for search or inspection of the Original
Record and Proceedings of the Sessions Court (lying in the
High Court of Gujarat), the same will be permitted only by
orders of the Hon’ble Court, in the presence of an Officer of the
concerned Head of the Department and taking copies of
documents of Record & Proceedings will not be allowed. -
However, he/she may be allowed for preparing notes/crux of the
concerned Record and Proceedings.
_ All are informed to act accordingly.
By Order of the Hon’ble Chief Justice
ApeDate : 03.09.2025 sistrar (Judicial)
